semantic_contract.metadata_xml_status: upstream AppEEARS file is not well-formed XML because its citation contains an unescaped ampersand at line 277; metadata semantics are cross-checked against the hash-bound README and request JSON without rewriting the source

science_acquisitions.definition: one unique UTC timestamp with an LST raster and exact same-timestamp QC and cloud rasters
science_acquisitions.missing_all_fill_lst_outputs: expected AppEEARS behavior, not a source error

pixel_acceptance.qc_mandatory_bits_1_0: 00 (Pixel produced by TES; official best-quality filter)
pixel_acceptance.other_qc_bits: retained as diagnostics and not used for additional post-hoc thresholds
pixel_acceptance.water_rule: retain both 0 land and 1 water when all LST/QC/cloud rules pass; water is not an invalidity flag in the product or dissertation
pixel_acceptance.fill_rule: reject NaN and GeoTIFF nodata; never impute
pixel_acceptance.physically_impossible_rule: reject values outside the official scaled product valid range; do not add an urban-temperature clipping threshold

unit.source_geotiff: Kelvin Float32, AppEEARS scale_factor=1 and add_offset=0

future_scene_mapping.pixel_stage: apply finite, official valid-range, QC mandatory 00, and separate clear-cloud rules
future_scene_mapping.per_acquisition: overlap-area-weighted mean of accepted pixel values intersecting each 500 m scene
future_scene_mapping.per_acquisition_coverage: record accepted intersection area divided by scene area
future_scene_mapping.timestamp_rule: never merge distinct timestamps, including same-day acquisitions
future_scene_mapping.day_night_rule: include every accepted timestamp; UTC and derived Asia/Seoul local time are provenance only
future_scene_mapping.period_aggregation: arithmetic mean of accepted per-acquisition scene means; each accepted acquisition has equal weight and is not coverage-weighted

unresolved_fields.reason: The dissertation requires sufficient and complete geographic coverage but supplies no numeric threshold.
Neither the dissertation nor product documentation defines the minimum temporal sample count for the annual response.
No accepted rule defines required seasonal/monthly coverage or maximum temporal imbalance.
